SkyTruth Analysis

Report Description///THIS IS AN UPDATE TO NRC REPORT 1299206/// UPDATE: THE NEW AMOUNT OF THE RELEASE IS 41 POUNDS OF ETHYLENE OXIDE. THE RELEASE HAS BEEN SECURED. DURING THE EVENT THE COMPANY CONDUCTED FENCE LINE AIR MONITORING WITH NO MATERIAL WAS DETECTED. UPDATE TO NRC REPORT: 1299141: CALLER STATED THE TOWER CONTAINING THE RELEASED PRODUCT IS INCREASING IN PRESSURE THAT IS RESULTING IN THE EPISODE BURPS OF RELEASES OF ETHYLENE OXIDE. CALLER STATED AIR MONITORING IS TAKING PLACE WITH NO CURRENT OFFSITE IMPACTS AT THE INCIDENT LOCATION. ORIGINAL REPORT IS BELOW: CALLER REPORTED A FS RESORBER HAD AN INCREASE IN PRESSURE WHICH CAUSED A RELEASE OF ETHYLENE OXIDE AT A CHEMICAL FACILITY DUE TO A RECENT COLD WEATHER FREEZE. CALLER REPORTED AIR MONITORING IS IN PROGRESS. CALLER STATED THERE ARE NO OFFSITE IMPACTS.

properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 859331 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: ALCOA, INC.
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 859331
Incident Time: 2008-01-10 13:00:00
Nearest City: Robbinsville, NC
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: RESIDUAL OIL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: ALCOA, INC.
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Sheen Size: 5 feet by 10 feet (area 50 sq. ft.)
Reported Spill Volume: 1 gallons
Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0 gallons
SOME TIME DURING THE NIGHT OF JANUARY 9, 2008, A PVC LINE THAT IS USED TO PUMP WATER FROM THE LAKE FAILED AND WET THE PACKING AROUND THE SUMP PUMP AT OUTFALL #003. THE FAILURE OF THE PVC LINE WENT UNDETECTED AND THE PUMP CONTINUED TO BRING IN LAKE WATER WHICH FLOODED THE BASEMENT OF THE POWERHOUSE. THE WATER WASHED RESIDUAL OILS OFF OF THE FLOOR OF THE POWERHOUSE AND OILY WATER WAS DISCHARGED THROUGH THE SUMP AT OUTFALL #003. DURING MORNING ROUNDS THE SHIFT MECHANIC NOTICED THE OIL SHEEN ON THE LAKE AND THE WATER ON THE FLOOR OF THE POWERHOUSE. THE PUMP WHICH BRINGS WATER INTO THE POWERHOUSE WAS IMMEDIATELY SHUT OFF AND THE SUPERVISOR WAS CONTACTED. THE SHIFT SUPERVISOR CONTACTED THE ENVIRONMENTAL DEPARTMENT AROUND 8:30 TO REPORT THE RELEASE AND IMMEDIATELY SENT CREWS TO RETRIEVE A BOAT AND OIL ABSORBENT BOOMS TO START TO CLEAN UP THE RELEASE. IT IS ESTIMATED THAT LESS THEN 1 GALLON OF RESIDUAL OIL WAS WASHED OFF THE BASEMENT FLOOR OF THE POWERHOUSE AND RELEASED INTO THE LAKE.

UNCERTAINTIES: A POINT SOURCE COULD NOT BE DETERMINED. SEVERAL PIPELINES WERE IN THE VICINITY OF THE ANOMALY, AND AN OIL FACILITY WAS PRESENT TO THE SOUTHWEST, BUT THE ANOMALY WAS NOT CLEARLY ASSOCIATED WITH ANY OF THESE. THUS, CONFIDENCE THAT THIS WAS OIL WAS LIMITED TO MEDIUM. /// NOAA/NESDIS MPSR ISSUED FOR: GULF OF AMERICA ///

Nearest City: Irwindale, CA

Material: SULFURIC ACID
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: DAVIS WIRE COMPANY
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 10000 gallons
THE CALLER REPORTED THAT STORAGE TANKS AT THE FACILITY ARE LEAKING DUE TO THE TANKS NOT BEING PROPERLY MAINTAINED. CALLER STATES THAT THESE TANKS HAVE BEEN LEAKING MATERIALS FOR 12-15 YEARS AT A RATE OF 100-200 GALLONS (PER WEEK) INTO THE GROUND. APPROXIMATELY 200-300 GALLONS (PER WEEK) OF THE MATERIAL WAS DUMPED INTO THE SEWER SYSTEM. ON 25-APR-2008 A DISCHARGE OF MORE THAN 1,000 GALLONS OCCURRED. THE SUSPECTED RESPONSIBLE PARTY HAS BEEN PRACTICING ILLEGAL DUMPING AND UNSAFE WORKING CONDITIONS FOR SEVERAL YEARS. TWO DEATHS OCCURRED ON THE PROPERTY WHEN AN INDIVIDUAL FELL THROUGH A ROOF THAT WAS BADLY CORRODED BY HYDROCHLORIC ACID. ANOTHER INDIVIDUAL DIED DUE TO A FORKLIFT FALLING ON TOP OF HIM WHILE REPAIRS WERE GOING ON THE FORKLIFT. CALLER ALSO STATES THAT AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF INDIVIDUALS SUSTAINED CHEMICAL BURN INJURIES. THE SUSPECTED RESPONSIBLE PARTY TERMINATES ANY EMPLOYEES THAT REPORT OR NOTICE THE ILLEGAL ACTIVITIES AT THE FACILITY. THERE ARE 6 TANKS AT THE FACILITY, 3 CONTAINING SULFURIC ACID.

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 33.816774, -118.001824 (Approximated from street_address)
Report DescriptionOVERVIEW: ORANGE COUNTY FIRE DEPARTMENT (OCFD) REPORTS A LARGE EVACUATION ORDER FOR SEVERAL BLOCKS IN GARDEN GROVE, CA (POP. 172K) HAS BEEN ESTABLISHED DUE TO A HAZARDOUS MATERIALS INCIDENT. THERE ARE NO REPORTED INJURIES OR FATALITIES. SUMMARY: • ON MAY 21, OCFD RESPONDED TO REPORTS OF A HAZARDOUS CHEMICAL INCIDENT AT AN AEROSPACE COMPANY. O UPON ARRIVING THEY FOUND A 34K GALLON TANK CONTAINING METHYL METHACRYLATE, A VOLATILE LIQUID USED TO MAKE PLASTIC, WAS RELEASING GAS. O FIREFIGHTERS CONDUCTED A SUCCESSFUL OPERATION TO COOL THE CHEMICAL BUT WERE UNABLE TO COMPLETE MITIGATION OF THE SITUATION DUE TO AN INOPERABLE VALVE ON THE TANK. O AUTHORITIES ARE WORKING WITH THE MANUFACTURER, A THIRD-PARTY CONTRACTOR, AND HAZARDOUS MATERIALS TEAMS TO MITIGATE THE SITUATION. • THERE IS NO ACTIVE LEAK OR PLUME. • THE TANK IS UNABLE TO BE SECURED OR MITIGATED. O AUTHORITIES REPORT THAT THE TANK COULD FAIL AND SPILL OR EXPLODE. • IT IS UNCLEAR WHAT CAUSED THE TANK FAILURE. ACTIONS: • FEMA REPORTS APPROXIMATELY 10,311 PEOPLE ARE UNDER A MANDATORY EVACUATION ORDER. • THERE ARE TWO EVACUATION CENTERS WITH AN UNKNOWN NUMBER OF OCCUPANTS. • THE ORANGE COUNTY EMERGENCY OPERATIONS CENTER HAS BEEN ACTIVATED.

properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 962222 - Medium Affected: OTHER - Suspected Responsible Party: WHEELABRATOR CLAREMONT CO.
properties.content:

Incident Time: 2010-10-28 19:45:00
Nearest City: Claremont, NH
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: FLYASH/LIME/WATER MIXTURE
Medium Affected: OTHER
Suspected Responsible Party: WHEELABRATOR CLAREMONT CO.
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 5 gallons
ON 10/28/2010 EE WAS CLEANING CONVEYOR SCREW TO PREPARE FOR MAINTENANCE AND NOTICED THAT A 2 INCH GAP IN METAL RAIL ON FLOOR ALLOWED APPROXIMATELY 5 GALLONS OF FLYASH/LIME/WATER TO LEAVE THE BUILDING THROUGH THE DOOR AND DEPOSIT ON THE PAVEMENT IMMEDIATELY OUTSIDE OF THE ASH BAY BUILDING. EE IMMEDIATELY RESPONDED TO SPILL W/ SPEEDY DRY, CONTAINERIZED THE MATERIAL, LABELED CONTAINERS AND PLACED MATERIAL IN STORAGE. SAMPLE SENT TO LAB AND MATERIAL CAME BACK WITH CADMIUM LEVEL OF 1.2 PPM. REPORTED TO NHDES @ ~1:00 PM TUESDAY 14 DEC. 2010. INCIDENT BEING REPORTED EVEN THOUGH IT IS NOT CLEAR THAT REPORTING IS REQUIRED DUE TO RECEIPT OF LAB RESULTS TODAY.

properties.content:
Report Details

Incident Type: PIPELINE

Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: PACIFIC GAS & ELECTRIC
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 37.793921, -121.221551 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** AT APPROXIMATELY 0400 HOURS ON JUNE 17, 2013, THERE WAS A STRUCTURE FIRE. THE FIRE ALSO DAMAGED THE DOOR OF THE HOUSE AT THE ADJOINING PROPERTY, AFTER SPREADING TO THE WOODEN DIVIDING FENCE BETWEEN THE TWO PROPERTIES. THE CAUSE OF THE FIRE HAS NOT BEEN DETERMINED; HOWEVER, THE MANTECA FIRE DEPARTMENT INDICATED THAT A SPARK FROM THE ELECTRIC METER MIGHT HAVE IGNITED GAS ESCAPING FROM A LEAK ON THE SERVICE LINE. THE FIRE WAS CALLED INTO PG&E AT 0434. THE FIRE DEPARTMENT SHUT OFF THE GAS AT 0450. A GSR RESPONDED AT 0526, AND A GAS CREW ARRIVED ON SCENE AT 0600 TO BEGIN MAKING REPAIRS. NO INJURIES OR FATALITIES WERE REPORTED, AND NO MEDIA CREWS WERE ON SITE. THIS INCIDENT IS REPORTABLE TO THE DOT AND CPUC BECAUSE THE DAMAGES SUSTAINED WERE GREATER THAN $50,000, AND PRELIMINARY INFORMATION INDICATES THAT PG&E FACILITIES MAY HAVE BEEN THE CAUSE OF THE FIRE.
